about_the_game:
🔮Clumsy Witch is a whimsical yet strategic rogue-lite deckbuilder where you step into the shoes of a hopelessly clumsy apprentice witch on a mission to pass her magical final exam. Your only hope? A chaotic mix of elemental spell cards and magical little creatures called Chibis.

Channel the powers of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air to craft powerful combos. Build your deck, experiment with synergies, and unlock evolving strategies as you progress through randomized stages. Just don't drop your wand again...

💫 Chibi Companions

  • Collect adorable, passive-effect Chibis—each one offers unique bonuses based on your playstyle.

  • Meet conditions to evolve Chibis into more powerful versions with stronger effects.

  • Strategically build your Chibi lineup like Jokers in Balatro to maximize synergy.

🔥 Elemental Combos

  • Play elemental cards in clever combinations: three of a kind, opposites, full sets, and more.

  • Discover new combo formulas and increase your Element Power to earn higher scores.

🎓 Witch Exam Awaits

  • Rise through increasingly difficult stages, each with new rules and random challenges.

  • Unlock new cards, Chibis, and relics that change the way you play.

  • Fail, learn, adapt—and try again. Even the best witches fall off their broom a few times!

If you love cute chaos, strategic deckbuilding, and chasing the perfect combo run, Clumsy Witch is ready to put your spellcraft to the test!
